Theme gallery主题画廊

Seven factory themes. The three community schemes are free; the four brand schemes ship with the Pro build. Every swatch below is read from that theme's JSON — not sampled from a screenshot.7 套出厂主题。3 套社区配色免费；4 套品牌配色随付费包交付。下面每个色块都直接读自该主题的 JSON，不是从截图上吸色。

zsh — ember
❯ ~/proj main
❯ eza --group-directories-first
assets/      README.md
build.sh    run.sh
❯ git diff --stat
 app/main.lua | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
+ spawn("agent --watch")
- pcall(loadfile("agent"))
❯▍
[ERROR] exit 1   [WARN] retry 2/5   [SUCCESS] done

Values come from Profiles[0] in config/themes/<name>.json: ANSI 0–15, background, foreground, cursor. Real screens come from the same terminal workflow; screenshots are not bound to one palette per card — use the swatches for exact colors.色值来自 config/themes/<name>.json 的 Profiles[0]：ANSI 0–15、背景、前景、光标。真机图取自同一套终端工作流；截图不逐套绑定色板 —— 精确颜色以上方 swatch 为准。

FIGfree
./scripts/theme.sh --list — current factory list (ember / voltage / parchment / ledger + community). See Themes & auto../scripts/theme.sh --list — 当前出厂列表（ember / voltage / parchment / ledger + 社区）。详见换肤与跟随。
